definitions.gloss: safety fence; protective barrier; guard rail
definitions.explanation: A fence or railing put up to keep people away from something dangerous — machinery, a construction site, a platform edge, or a drop. Common on signage and in workplace safety rules.

examples.japanese: {工事現場|こうじげんば}に{安全柵|あんぜんさく}を{設置|せっち}した。
examples.english: A safety fence was installed at the construction site.

examples.japanese: {機械|きかい}の{周|まわ}りには{安全柵|あんぜんさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A safety barrier is required around the machine.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{落|お}ちないように、{階段|かいだん}の{上|うえ}に{安全柵|あんぜんさく}を{取|と}り{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: We fitted a safety gate at the top of the stairs so the child would not fall.

examples.japanese: {安全柵|あんぜんさく}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて{線路|せんろ}に{入|はい}るのは、{大変|たいへん}{危険|きけん}な{行為|こうい}だ。
examples.english: Climbing over the safety barrier onto the tracks is an extremely dangerous act.

notes:
{柵|さく} is a fence of posts and rails, so the compound names the barrier by its purpose rather than its material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}を{設置|せっち}する: to install a safety fence
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to climb over a safety barrier
- {安全柵|あんぜんさく}の{内側|うちがわ}: inside the barrier

SIMILAR WORDS:
- フェンス: fence — the general loanword, without the safety purpose
- ガードレール: guardrail — specifically the metal barrier along a road
- {手|て}すり: handrail — for holding on to, not for keeping people out
